prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original transparent WoW popup animation bases, ONE horizontal three-frame sprite strip.
Canvas: exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells in ONE horizontal row, 3:1 wide canvas, preferably 1536x512. Actual alpha transparency outside the artwork. No grid, labels, frame numbers or dividers.
The specified FULL text must be visible and readable in ALL THREE cells. Draw the bold outlined wordmark ONCE, duplicate it across the three cells with the SAME lettering, line breaks, scale, tilt, position and center anchor. Animate the effects around it. Small hand-drawn differences acceptable.
Frame progression: left = onset with contained movement; middle = peak with the strongest effect; right = aftershock with effects dispersing or recoiling. Coherent variants of ONE design, not three unrelated illustrations.
Readability at 256x256: oversized chunky lettering, thick contrasting outline, strong simple silhouette, mostly opaque colors, broad effect shapes and minimal fine details. No tiny supporting text or numbers.
Spacing: each entire sticker including lettering, shadows, swooshes, netting, dust and every particle fits inside the middle 60% width and height of its OWN square cell. Leave 20% empty transparent margin on EVERY side of EACH cell. Three isolated stickers with wide clear gutters. Never crop artwork to fit.
No characters, no real team crests or sponsor marks, no game logos, no watermark, no actual stadium scene, no painted checkerboard, no solid image background, no generic fiery explosions.
Specific visual and motion direction: Football broadcast achievement. Huge warm GOLD and IVORY bold italic athletic lettering with thick dark NAVY outline, backed by THREE abstract GOLD impact slashes and a shallow teal curved ribbon. No trophy or crest. Three clear broad marks, no small numerals. Onset: three short slashes; peak: three bold sweeping marks and restrained gold gleam; aftershock: marks break into small gold ticks. Exact word HAT-TRICK! including the hyphen, on one line or two lines HAT- above TRICK!.
Text (verbatim, once per cell): "HAT-TRICK!". Keep the exact wording and punctuation in all three cells.
